title: Can’t See the Forest for the Trees

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The later chapters consider AI, limits, and possibilities for intervention without promising a guaranteed rescue.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Optimism appears as a commitment to useful action while difficult consequences remain visible.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book invites readers to question both technological enthusiasm and the comfort of resignation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it for a personal inquiry into seeing more clearly and remaining responsible for what follows.
